svg.text: Columns 1–29 left to right, rows 1–35 top to bottom. Jack and ESP32 USB-C at the top edge, charging port at the bottom, SD card out of the right side.
screen up, header at the top

Same holes seen from the back. Pin colour = colour of the wire soldered there; gold pins get no wire.
